admitted_local_behavior: Proposal Template versions, Proposal Versions, typed child lines, exact-version scoped decisions, and render preparations are API-owned immutable canonical writes over API-PC-009 truth.
Proposal Versions bind exact Project/Specification/Product/template versions and independently reconciled integer economics; revisions append and decisions do not inherit.
Template metadata binds a tenant-private object reference and an exact clean EvidenceArtifact/v1; unsupported PDFs remain INVALID with a validation report.
Render preparation is not provider execution, artifact readback, delivery, or customer send.
One exact latest accepted Proposal Version can authorize an approval-ready PO draft only with the matching approved bid, human selection, quote, supplier profile, and specification lines.
Every admitted mutation is atomic with one P110 receipt/event/NO_EFFECT outbox and exact readback; no provider effect is reachable.

remaining_dependency_holds.dependency: effect-admitted PO release/send plus normalized supplier acknowledgement and source readback
least-privilege restoration of exact Account/Opportunity runtime SELECT used by A2/A2S

consumer_rules: Pin command/read-model version, proposal producer SHA, A2P-compatible procurement producer SHA, upstream producer SHAs, and exact candidate SHA independently.
Do not create a local canonical proposal, line, decision, quote-economics, template, render-artifact, or Purchase Order writer.
Do not submit a client grant in a command body; D1C must resolve it server-side from the authenticated Portal identity and exact object/version grant.
Treat render PREPARED and P110 DOMAIN_COMMITTED as internal finality only; neither means document rendered, sent, delivered, client accepted, PO released, or supplier acknowledged.
Keep every overlapping legacy mutation path dark or unreachable for an admitted tenant; G1 cannot have dual writers.

No consumer may infer upload, malware-provider execution, render, proposal send, Shopify publish, PO release, supplier commitment, managed migration, deployment, or any external effect from this handoff.
